about: Shared normalization vectors for the review term match (hub: crates/agent-server/src/review_terms.rs; civitai: its twin). Rule: NFKC, then remove Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, then lowercase (full case mapping), then every run of chars that are not Alphabetic or Numeric becomes one space, trimmed. JS: s.normalize('NFKC'), strip /\p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point}/gu, .toLowerCase(), .replace(/[^\p{Alphabetic}\p{N}]+/gu, ' ').trim(). Each normalize vector names the step that makes it pass: removing that step must change the output. Non-sensitive inputs only.

normalize.note: sharp s stays one letter; no ss expansion
dotted capital I lowercases to i + U+0307, which is not Alphabetic, so it splits the word
